prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Custom Pet Creation Stage: Redesign pick_friend screen layout into a stage workspace with live companion animation and interactive choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Design Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select traits and preview your pet live before finalizing adoption.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "playful", "label": "Live Companion Preview"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "style": "highlight", "action": "choose"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Companion Preview Screen: Add a dedicated controls preview screen before home_intro showcasing keyboard shortcuts and tray icon controls.
   config: {"new_controls_guide": {"headline": "Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Right-click your pet anytime to access quick settings, talk, or minimize to system tray.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "animation", "style": "rounded", "label": "Desktop Control Guide"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Got It, Let's Go!", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_controls_guide", "home_intro"]}
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Interactive Story Mode Onboarding Flow: Transform the story screen into a story scroll layout with interactive companion personality choices.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Your Companion Journey Begins", "body": "Discover how desktop pets interact with your workspace and pick your path.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}, "choose_path": {"layout": "two_column", "show_step_counter": true}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Sign-In Flow Reorder: Move sign_in to occur after waiting so users adopt and preview their pet before authenticating.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync & Pet Saved Reassurance Hint: Display a hint explaining that signing in links your desktop pet to your cloud profile so progress is never lost.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in secures your pet traits so your companion follows you on any device."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Waiting Status Stream: Show detailed real-time rendering status and animated progress updates on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Generating Your Desktop Pet...", "body": "We are preparing high-res animations and desktop collision scripts.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
6: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Pet Accessory Badge Incentive: Offer an exclusive starter accessory badge incentive on the path choice screen.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Includes exclusive Starter Crown accessory badge!", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Accessory Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [adoption, layout] Grid View Pet Trait Browser: Switch pick_friend to a grid layout displaying all available pet styles side-by-side.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "show_step_counter": true}}
8: [home, notification] Background Render System Notification: Add option to send system notification when the pet finished spawning while app is minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We'll ping you when your desktop companion is ready to pop up!"}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Quick Launch Controls Guidance: Clarify post-onboarding controls in home_intro copy to explain tray icon behavior and drag commands.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Drag your pet anywhere on your screen. Access settings anytime via system tray icon."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigned pick_friend screen retains its job of allowing the user to select a pet.
Adding a new controls preview screen before home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Redesigning story and choose_path layouts is permitted inside onboarding.
Reordering sign_in after adoption/waiting is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Adding a hint to sign_in explaining cloud sync is allowed inside onboarding.
Updating waiting screen status stream and time estimate for a real wait is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions an exclusive starter accessory badge extra, violating Rule 3.
Changing pick_friend to a grid layout is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding a notification prompt on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
Updating home_intro text for clarity is allowed inside onboarding.
